claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: SDM25N is a delta-opioid receptor antagonist with no known cytotoxic mechanism in human cancer cells; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive, and its anti-dengue NS4B activity is irrelevant in this screen.
